programme.desc: Baloo and Bagheera thought Mowgli needed their protection at all times, but Mowgli thought differently. Why, he could fight like a bear and plan like a panther, too! Mowgli tries to save his new friend.

programme.desc: With this sweet collection of Disney Christmas stories, little ones are sure to be carried off to sleep full of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Soul

programme.title: Driven To Win
programme.desc: Lightning McQueen loves racing. But when a new racer arrives, will Lightning still be the fastest car on the track?

programme.title: Lead The Way
programme.desc: Follow along with word-for-word naration as Lightning McQueen discovers the wonders and importance of having a special somebody to help lead the way.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Mater
programme.desc: Mater and the Gas Caps, records a hit song, Mater becomes a rock legend. Then Lightning joins Mater's band for the rock concert of the century!

programme.title: Mater Private Eye
programme.desc: Detective Mater is hot on the trail of a dastardly car-napping! When Tiais sister goes missing, Mater is the only car she can turn to. With this tow truck on the case, anything can happen.

programme.title: Radiator Springs 500 1/2
programme.desc: Lightning and his companions concur that Stanley, the man who founded Radiator Springs. Lightning forced to defend Stanley's honour when Sandy interrupt the festivities and challenge him to a race.

programme.title: A Family Mystery
programme.desc: Read along with Disney! Coco is the celebration of a lifetime. Follow along as the discovery of a generations-old mystery leads to a most extraordinary and surprising family reunion.

programme.title: Coco

programme.title: Miguel And The Amazing Alebrijes
programme.desc: Goldie and Bear have fun learning to fly with a lost broomstick. But when the owner is found, they must say goodbye. Read this adorable Disney storybook!

programme.title: Tekken: Kazuya's Revenge
programme.desc: Suffering from amnesia, a young man trying to discover his true identity is kidnapped by an underground crime organization and turned into a ruthless assassin

programme.title: Untraceable
programme.desc: A FBI secret service agent, gets caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with a serial killer who knows that people will log onto an "untraceable" website where he conducts violent and painful murders LIVE on the net. The more people who log on and enter the website, the quicker and more violently the victim dies.

programme.title: The Catcher Was A Spy
programme.desc: With an ensemble cast, this gripping, espionage thriller brings to life the true story of Moe Berg a World War II spy. His mission: go behind enemy lines in Europe to assassinate the Nazi's chief nuclear scientist before the Germans develop an atomic bomb. Berg must rely on his steel-trap intellect in a high-stakes game of cat and mouse - with the fate of the world hanging in the balance.

programme.title: Out Of Death
programme.desc: From the producers of The Irishman & Lone Survivor comes this thrilling story of Jack Harris (Bruce Willis) who must tap into his killer instincts to survive the wilderness and the human predators as he tries to help a woman who witnesses a crime and finds herself running from a rural mountain town's corrupt police department after she took a video of police killing a drug dealer.

programme.title: Redline
programme.desc: Redline is an auto/action thriller that features an extensive exotic car collection Phantom Rolls Royce, Lamborghini Murcielago, Enzo Ferrari, Ferrari F430, Ferrari Scaglietti and two Mercedes SLR McLaren AMGs. The film follows a gorgeous young automobile fanaticize driver who becomes part of illegal drag racing competitions organized by exotic car fanatics.

programme.title: Meet Mere Man Ke
programme.desc: Thakur Jagat Pratap Singh, a man of high principles falls in love with a girl and wants to marry her. However, the difference in their social statuses threatens to maim his plans.

programme.title: Kirayadar
programme.desc: Laxmi Abhyankar and her employed daughter Jaya live on rent in a flat on Pali Hill, Mumbai they rented years ago from Lucknow-based Kundanlal Choudhury. His son Anil comes to Mumbai and gets a job.

programme.title: Kudrat
programme.desc: Chandramukhi visits Shimla and learns that she is a reincarnation of Paro, a girl who was raped and murdered. Plagued by her dark past, she attempts to bring the culprits to justice.

programme.title: Kangan
programme.desc: Sunil lives a middle-classed lifestyle in a village in India along with his widowed mom, Janki. He is studying Medicine in the city, is in love with his childhood sweetheart, Shanta, and everyone expects them to get married soon. However, Janki does not approve of Shanta, finds her uncouth and illiterate, and instead approves of Shobha and arranges Sunil's marriage with her.

programme.title: Kya Super Kool Hai Hum
programme.desc: A comedy film that tells the story of two friends, who dream of becoming successful actors. They get caught up in a series of misadventures when they try to impress two women and end up in hilarious situations. The movie features humor, witty one-liners, and a fast-paced storyline.

programme.title: Sunday
programme.desc: Voice actress Sehar wakes with a hangover to find she’s lost an entire day. As she retraces Sunday’s events, she becomes the prime suspect in a murder, chased by a gangster and an unhinged cabbie, Ballu.

programme.title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baaraat
programme.desc: Raja rapes Mala and the court orders him to marry her. His family continues to torture Mala and attempts to kill her, but she manages to win over Raja and his family with her good deeds.

programme.title: Mission Istanbul
programme.desc: An action thriller film that follows the story of a journalist, Vikas, who is sent to Istanbul to cover a breaking news story. However, he becomes embroiled in a dangerous conspiracy involving international terrorism and political corruption. The movie features high-octane action sequences and explores themes of courage, patriotism, and the importance of journalistic integrity in a thrilling and suspenseful plot.

programme.title: R D Burman – Musical Maverick
